features.name: FullBleedLayout
features.description: supportsFullBleed flag in manifest allowing seamless placement in full-width modern SharePoint section columns.

features.name: DualLayoutModes
features.description: Toggle dynamically between Tabbed View (pill/underline) and Accordion View (collapsible panels).

features.name: ChildContentBlocks
features.description: Configurable child content slots supporting Rich Cards, Embed/iFrame tools, British Metric Stats (£), and Quick Links.

features.name: FluentUI2DesignSystem
features.description: Built 100% on Microsoft Fluent UI 2 (@fluentui/react-components) with native SharePoint theme inheritance, Griffel tokens, and dark/light adaptive surfaces.

features.name: PropertyPaneCustomisation
features.description: Comprehensive 3-page interactive SharePoint properties sidebar for configuring layout, sections, badges (Core, Real-time, Interactive, etc.), British financial metrics (£), cards, and presets in Edit Mode.

features.name: InlineCanvasAndCardEditing
features.description: Direct WYSIWYG in-place editing for container title, subtitle, card titles, descriptions, and metrics on the canvas in Edit Mode, paired with contextual floating card action toolbars.

features.name: ComposableInnerCardsAndHoverToolbox
features.description: Inner composable items for cards (Text, Button, CTA, Divider, Editorial, Hero, Image, Gallery, Video) with contextual (+) hover insertion bars and toolbox popover.

features.name: SharePointGlobalTermStoreIntegration
features.description: Integration with SharePoint Global Term Store taxonomy terms for selecting and rendering interactive managed metadata tag pills.

features.name: LiveDataAPIFields
features.description: Dynamic real-time text and metric fields bound to REST/Graph APIs with JSONPath parsing, auto-refresh intervals, and GBP (£) formatting.

features.name: CardGridSpanningAndContainerLayout
features.description: Card-level CSS grid spanning (1-4 columns, 1-2 rows) and container-level grid column management (1-4 columns or auto-fit).

features.name: IndependentCardHeightAndEqualRowScaling
features.description: Configurable card height modes supporting both independent content height scaling (fit-content) and equal row height scaling (match tallest card in row) with container and card-level overrides.

features.name: FluentUI2SkeletonShimmers
features.description: Fluent UI 2 Skeleton and SkeletonItem pulse shimmers replacing empty layout shifts during Live Data metric queries and Term Store taxonomy loading.

features.name: FluentUI2ToastNotifications
features.description: Fluent UI 2 Toast notification system for non-intrusive visual feedback during card boundary resizing, saves, and JSON actions.

features.name: DashboardJSONPortability
features.description: Complete dashboard JSON template export and import in Property Pane Page 1 for rapid configuration replication across SharePoint sites.

features.name: TurnerAndTownsendBrandPaletteAndIndependentBackgrounds
features.description: Integration of Turner & Townsend July 2025 brand colors into text/highlight ribbons and independent background color customization across Web Part canvas, Sections, and Cards.

features.name: LivePhysicalCardResizePreviewAndSharePointMoveIsolation
features.description: Real-time physical card dimension expansion/shrinking during boundary dragging with live measurement badge, and full suppression/isolation from SharePoint Online native Move Web Part drag-and-drop controller.

features.name: MiniCollapsibleCardTags
features.description: Mini collapsible tile labeled 'Tags' with tag icon and count badge on cards. Default view is collapsed, expanding on demand to reveal interactive tags.

features.name: VisualBrandColorPopovers
features.description: Interactive visual popup color pickers with categorized Turner & Townsend brand palettes (TT Primary, TT Secondary, Backgrounds & Neutrals, Brand Tints), active selection rings, and custom HEX input for Web Part canvas, Section, and Card backgrounds.

features.name: SharePointDocumentLibraryBackupAndRestore
features.description: Complete self-contained dashboard backup and restore targeting SharePoint Document Library ('Dashboards') in 'Backups' or 'Templates' subfolders with timestamped version control, cross-site portability, and auto-save on page exit.

features.name: CustomBrandSVGIconsAndDynamicIconStyling
features.description: Extensible custom corporate SVG icon collection registry seamlessly integrated alongside SPFx Fluent UI 2 icons, featuring visual color pickers for icon glyphs and rounded background boxes with full 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% brand tints.

features.name: PropertyPaneAccordionAndVisualIconField
features.description: Clean collapsible accordion layout (displayGroupsAsAccordion) across all 3 property pane pages with logical card sub-groups, collapsed non-essential fields, and PropertyPaneIconField connecting the property pane to the full 229-icon modal.
